column5: Relocates the clean-room wall so the map itself sits on the contaminated side, fixing who may see what and naming the spec as the only laundering channel
Fixes which agents Notes-level rules bind -- planning inside the wall, construction reached only through clean artefacts -- and refuses to mint a second carrier
Extends the define-positively standing rule over the charter, striking or rewriting every contrastive entry as a standing constraint on future entries
Routes every named constraint to the artefact that carries it across the wall, and expires the one with no carrier
Adds the precondition that the map may not close on an unaudited constraint list, binding the closing decision itself
Records cycles as a refused shape already enforced by const-evaluation, so pardosa builds no mechanism of its own
Declines a ninth noun for the failure vocabulary because a rejected program has no runtime condition to name
Owes a compile-fail fixture so an inexpressibility claim is observed rather than inferred, damping the fails-open shape
States finiteness and acyclicity for the non-Rust reader who has no compiler to learn it from, inside a clause that already exists
Ratifies the standing rule that a foreign corpus is advice, and refuses per-domain adjudication of a corpus this map does not own
Lays down the checkable corollary that no ruling may rest solely on a foreign ADR (spans 5/6 with the RULED 116 narrowing, higher taken)
Confines foreign citations to PAR ADRs so no normative clause is uncheckable by the only audience it binds
Fixes precedence rather than a carve-out -- advice cannot overturn a ruling -- so the named collision resolves by rule
Counts the class apart and shows three instances already name their own discharge, so no second rendering is manufactured
Sites the unmechanisable judgement in a venue the map already chose, composing rather than minting a second home for one kind of thing
Sets the record as one standing document edited in place rather than one accumulating per release, with git holding prior state
Refuses the gate that tends to grow where a venue is created, preserving record-without-a-gate intact
Declines a second rendering of which-standard, leaving the operator only the opaque discriminator and accepting that cost
Fixes the across-major regime -- artefacts never cross, the operator links both majors -- buying nothing the toolchain already gives
Rations the spec to pardosa's own boundary and withholds another tool's technique, leaving the named cost unmitigated
Executes the kind test to split container versioning downstream from the standard's discriminator, which stays here
Shapes the surface as one predicate-free operation reporting into an existing vocabulary, naming no lock, epoch, sequence or file
Takes the reversible direction at a freeze so a later minor may still publish it (spans 4/6, higher taken); symmetry becomes tested, not structural
Keeps the marker trait method-less so a future backend has nothing to break, preserving the orthogonal seals
Joins pieces the map recorded separately and never stated together, making an unmet non-negotiable visible in one sentence
Refuses a release that publishes an invariant-marked clause knowingly unmet, binding the mechanism and its suite to 0.5.1
Withdraws the marker a stranger would rely on as normative while the commitment itself survives, using an existing non-clause shape
Refuses to widen the marker test, keeping compiler-enforced breakage apart from quality judgement so no marked clause reopens
Files the erratum because the superseded headline is exactly the sentence a later reader would rely on and is now false
